description: This file defines the Tiptap class for handling rich text content, including conversion to HTML, text, Markdown, and extraction of headlines and titles. It also provides methods for inserting block IDs, media, resolving attachments, internal links, and post-processing images and links within the content. It is part of the Notesnook project and interacts with various utilities for HTML parsing, rewriting, and conversion.

classes.name: Tiptap
classes.description: A class for manipulating and converting rich text content, supporting HTML, Markdown, and text extraction, as well as media and attachment handling.

methods.name: toHTML
methods.description: Returns the raw HTML data stored in the Tiptap instance.

methods.name: toTXT
methods.description: Converts the HTML content to plain text.

methods.name: toMD
methods.description: Converts the HTML content to Markdown format.

methods.name: toHeadline
methods.description: Extracts the headline from the content.

methods.name: toTitle
methods.description: Extracts a title from the content with a maximum length of 150 characters.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches for a query string within the content, returning true if any token matches.

methods.name: insertBlockIds
methods.description: Inserts unique block IDs into various HTML elements.

methods.name: insertMedia
methods.description: Replaces image hashes with actual image sources using a provided resolve function.

methods.name: resolveAttachments
methods.description: Resolves and replaces attachment elements with actual content via a resolve function.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Extracts blocks and internal links from the content based on specified types.

methods.name: removeAttachments
methods.description: Removes attachments with specified hashes from the content.

methods.name: postProcess
methods.description: Processes the content to handle image attachments and internal links, saving attachments via a provided callback.
